text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out 
on an excursion with Phalaenopsis—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, a Paka Puchi. 
Heh, what an adorable thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Phalaenopsis 
pointed, 
I saw a claw machine filled with plushies 
modeled after various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, there were some placed 
in the club's break room as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have seen girls dozing off 
while fondly embracing them.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the others would be pleased 
if I brought a few back.
choice_data_list: Then is this where your pupil steps in?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Oho... Are you confident in your skills?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Then give it a try. 
I am counting on you for the juniors' 
sake!
